cases.expected: Nodes x and y should swap positions without being direct parents
cases.description: Test swapping two nodes that are not direct parent-child. Verify that the nodes swap positions correctly and their parent-child relationships are updated.

cases.expected: No change since nodes are identical
cases.description: Test swapping a node with itself. Expect no changes in the tree structure.

cases.expected: Nodes x and y should swap positions based on value
cases.description: Test swapping two nodes with different values. Verify that the swap happens based on the VALUE data element.
Test case where x is y's parent. Verify that x becomes y's parent correctly and the rest of the relationships are updated accordingly.
Test case where y is x's parent. Verify that y becomes x's parent correctly and the rest of the relationships are updated accordingly.

cases.expected: Root node changes if x or y is the root
cases.description: Test scenario where either x or y is the root node. Verify that the root node reference updates correctly.

cases.expected: Nodes x and y should swap positions without being direct parents
cases.description: Test swapping two nodes that are not direct parent-child based on VALUE. Verify that the nodes swap positions correctly and their parent-child relationships are updated.

cases.expected: Nodes x and y should swap positions based on key
cases.description: Test swapping two nodes with different keys. Verify that the swap happens based on the KEY data element.
Test case where x is y's parent based on VALUE. Verify that x becomes y's parent correctly and the rest of the relationships are updated accordingly.
Test case where y is x's parent based on KEY. Verify that y becomes x's parent correctly and the rest of the relationships are updated accordingly.

cases.expected: Root node changes if x or y is the root
cases.description: Test scenario where either x or y is the root node based on VALUE. Verify that the root node reference updates correctly.
Test scenario where the first node x is null. This should trigger a NullPointerException when attempting to access methods on x.
Test scenario where the second node y is null. This should trigger a NullPointerException when attempting to access methods on y.
Test scenario where the dataElement is null. This should trigger a NullPointerException when attempting to use the ordinal method on a null dataElement.
Test scenario where the dataElement is invalid. This should trigger an IllegalArgumentException when attempting to switch on an invalid dataElement.
